title: Company Secretary Associate
summary: Keeps a company compliant with company law (Companies Act 2013) and, for listed companies, stock market disclosure rules (SEBI LODR). Works in the secretarial team under the Company Secretary, handling board meetings, minutes, government filings and statutory records.
dailyDuties: Prepare notices and agendas for board and committee meetings
File ROC e-forms on the MCA portal
Make stock exchange disclosures under SEBI LODR
Update statutory registers and minutes books
Maintain the compliance calendar and chase deadlines
Gather records for the secretarial audit

skills.expectation: Track and meet Companies Act 2013 compliance for the company and subsidiaries
Prepare notices, agendas and minutes for board, committee and general meetings
File ROC e-forms and annual returns on the MCA portal on time
Make SEBI LODR stock exchange filings and disclosures for listed companies
Maintain statutory registers and minutes books
Prepare records and replies for the secretarial audit
Draft clear resolutions and correspond with directors, auditors and regulators
Run trading window closures and the insider trading database
Handle FEMA filings such as FC-GPR and the FLA return
Handle share allotments, transfers and ESOP paperwork
Keep compliance calendars and trackers in Excel
